_state: PROGRAMS DEPLOYED, ON-CHAIN STATE NOT INITIALIZED. The five program binaries are live and upgradeable under deployer authority. None of the per-program initialize instructions have been called yet, so token mints / admin / validator set / domain id / peer routers are all unset. Calling initialize is a separate operational step that must decide: (1) domain id for Solana mainnet; (2) initial admin authority (PDA vs deployer keypair vs Squads multisig); (3) initial validator set (the EVM mainnet validator is queued to be 0x2503 — Solana ValidatorRegistry uses 20-byte EVM-style addresses per the multisig-verifier parity work); (4) mint cap / token name / symbol on stable_naira; (5) peer registration for BSC/Ethereum/Base TokenMessengers. Until then these programs are inert and cannot mint, bridge, or attest.
_caveats: Same program keypair files (target/deploy/<name>-keypair.json) are used across localnet/devnet/mainnet per Anchor.toml. Anyone with access to those keypair files can also deploy/upgrade at the same address on any cluster they have funds on. The .so binaries were built today (2026-05-21) from main; no third-party audit at the time of deploy (commit history tags Phase 7 as 'audit-prep'). Multisig migration of upgrade authority remains the operational priority.

Decide Solana mainnet domain id and register reciprocal peer routes on BSC/Ethereum/Base mainnet TokenMessengers (1h timelock each on the EVM side)
